seo.default_description: LrGeniusAI — free, open-source AI plugin for Lightroom Classic. AI keywording, semantic search, photo culling, and face recognition. Runs AI models on your own machine with no extra software, or via Ollama, LM Studio, or cloud AI.
seo.keywords: Lightroom Classic, AI Plugin, Keywording, Semantic Search, llama.cpp, MLX, Ollama, ChatGPT, Photo Management, Image Description, Face Recognition, Local AI, Offline AI
